title: High-Speed Fiber ISP Customer Portal

A customer-facing telecom and internet service provider (ISP) portal enabling subscribers to explore fiber-optic internet plans, test bandwidth speeds, manage account subscriptions, and submit support tickets. title: Tier-1 Sports Betting & Gaming Platform Modernization
facts: Tier-1 Sports Betting & Gaming Platform Modernization (Sharp Gaming, OCT 2022 — JUN 2023). Role: Senior Frontend Developer. Stack: React, TypeScript, Redux, WebSockets, Performance Profiling, SonarQube. Led the enterprise frontend modernization and latency reduction initiative for a tier-1 UK sports betting and gaming operator (client of Sharp Gaming), migrating core betting and gaming features from legacy vanilla JavaScript to a resilient React and TypeScript ecosystem. Challenge: High-concurrency live gaming and sports betting demand strict real-time updates and sub-100ms UI interaction latencies. The legacy JavaScript codebase suffered from regression risks, tight coupling, and difficult third-party game integration. Implementation: - **Architecture Migration**: Led the migration from legacy monolithic JavaScript into modular React 18, TypeScript, and Redux Toolkit architectures. - **Third-Party Game Engine Integration**: Built standardized integration layers and iframe messaging protocols for third-party gaming vendor content. - **Latency & Render Optimization**: Profiled memoization, Redux selectors, and WebSocket event batching to eliminate unnecessary re-renders during high-volume live odds changes. - **Engineering Quality Gates**: Enforced strict TypeScript linting rules, automated testing pipelines, and mentored junior and mid-level developers through thorough code reviews. Outcomes: - Substantial reduction in frontend regression bugs and developer onboarding time. - Smoother real-time odds rendering without UI freezes during peak sporting events. - Documented in Sudheer's career experience at Sharp Gaming (Manchester, UK).

title: Smart HVAC & Cleanroom Air Engineering Platform
source: Extended Project Dossier (Industrial HVAC Engineering Client)
facts: Smart HVAC & Cleanroom Air Engineering Platform (Industrial HVAC Engineering Client, 2024 - 2025). Role: Full-Stack Developer. Stack: Next.js, React Hook Form, Zod, Framer Motion, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS. A technical engineering web platform for an industrial HVAC and cleanroom air handling specialist, featuring HVAC equipment specifications, airflow capacity calculators, and validated RFQ lead funnels. Challenge: Industrial cleanroom clients (pharmaceutical labs, microelectronics manufacturers, hospital operating rooms) require exacting air change per hour (ACH) calculations and compliance assurance before commissioning installations. Implementation: - **Strict Client-Side Validation**: Engineered multi-step engineering quote request forms validated with Zod schemas and React Hook Form, capturing room dimensions, particulate standards (ISO 14644), and filtration grades (HEPA/ULPA). - **Interactive Mechanical Showcase**: Built animated HVAC unit diagrams and airflow cycle visualizations using Framer Motion. - **Server-Side API Handling**: Processed and routed technical inquiries with validated JSON payloads and email dispatchers. Outcomes: - Reduced back-and-forth qualification calls by capturing complete mechanical specifications on initial submission. - High-performance, responsive layout optimized for facility managers and technical buyers.

title: Donor & Community Engagement Platform
facts: Donor & Community Engagement Platform (Non-Profit & Community Organization, 2024 - 2025). Role: Full-Stack Application Developer. Stack: FastAPI, Python, React, TypeScript, Vite, PostgreSQL, WebSockets, Vitest. A full-stack donor and community engagement web application connecting contributors with charitable initiatives, featuring real-time messaging, activity feeds, donor dashboards, and automated contribution logging. Outcomes: - Unified community discussion and contribution tracking into a single responsive portal. - Reliable asynchronous API architecture capable of sustaining spikes during fundraising campaigns.

title: Concurrent Multi-Store E-Commerce Delivery
facts: Concurrent Multi-Store E-Commerce Delivery (Crazy Techsol, MAY 2017 — JAN 2020). Role: Senior Developer & Technical Lead. title: Cloudflare-Native Edge Fashion E-Commerce Platform
source: Extended Project Dossier (Private Fashion & Apparel Brand)
facts: Cloudflare-Native Edge Fashion E-Commerce Platform (Private Fashion & Apparel Brand, 2024 - 2025). Role: Full-Stack Engineer. Stack: Cloudflare Workers, Hono, Cloudflare D1, Cloudflare R2, TypeScript. A modern, ultra-low latency fashion e-commerce storefront and API built entirely on Cloudflare's serverless edge infrastructure (Workers, Hono framework, D1 serverless SQL, and R2 object storage). Challenge: Traditional server-based e-commerce backends suffer from geographic latency spikes, high cloud hosting costs during idle periods, and slow asset loading during flash product drops. Implementation: - **Edge Routing & Middleware**: Built lightweight, type-safe API endpoints using Hono running on Cloudflare Workers across global edge locations. - **Serverless Relational Storage**: Implemented product catalogs, inventory states, and order records on Cloudflare D1 (SQLite at the edge) for instantaneous local reads. - **Zero-Egress Media Delivery**: Managed product lookbooks, high-resolution garment imagery, and assets using Cloudflare R2 object storage. Outcomes: - Sub-50ms response times globally with zero infrastructure server management. - Drastically reduced cloud hosting costs and eliminated cold-start delays.
